Area.evidence_source: [page/4/Text/9] Feelings of exhaustion, anxiety, and of being overwhelmed took control over body and mind and led to an overall sense of loss of control. All respondents described complete physical exhaustion in the weeks before the SA. They felt tired and completely worn out, and often attributed it to sleep problems: All reported severe insomnia.
